Chapter 73 Alternate (Recommended)

So what exactly is this sentence? After Han Kai heard Lingdi's worry, he turned back with a smile and replied:

"Hanhuang has no worries. This time, my majesty has brought an imperial decree. If the Han emperor is willing to surrender, my majesty is willing to follow the ancient Zhou Wu's etiquette. With the land of one county, the clan of the Han family and the survivors from all over the place have been arranged. With the title of Duke The land of the seven counties of the county will be used as a fief for the remnants of the Han Dynasty!"

Hearing Han Kai's answer, Emperor Ling was pleasantly surprised. He never thought that the emperor of Yu Kingdom would treat him like this? He originally thought that the emperor of Yu Kingdom would give him a nominal title, and then imprison him in one place to eat and die.

But I didn't expect that the Emperor Yuguo was as generous as the rumors outside, and he followed the example of the Zhou Dynasty to enfeoff the eight hundred princes, and Liu Han got a fief like the legacy of the Yin and Shang Dynasties, which was used as the incense of the ancestors of the ancestors.

This was really beyond the expectation of Emperor Ling, and as a fiefdom, it was also Pei County where Gao Zu cut the White Snake Uprising, which was the foundation of the Han Dynasty!

The local people's loyalty to the Liu family is also very high. If the Emperor Ling arrives there, he will not have to worry that he will not have the slightest resistance after he is sealed.

He will be killed by Yu Guo at will for any crime. This is to give himself peace of mind, so that he can surrender with peace of mind, and there will be no troubles.

This effect was useful, and Emperor Ling was very satisfied, and quickly expressed to Han Kai that he would surrender immediately, so he called all the officials in the city, prepared the ceremony, and waited for the emperor of Yuguo to come to perform the ceremony of surrendering and offering the country.

After Han Kai heard the sincere and eager answer, he expressed his respect again, and after some pleasantries, he left the hall, left Luoyang City with Wang Yun's company, and returned to the Royal Camp.

After returning to the camp, he exchanged pleasantries with the generals of the other three front armies, and then immediately sent a fast horse to Yingchuan County to report the situation of this mission, and asked Zhong Yu to move to Luoyang City to prepare to receive Lingdi's envoy. A gift of surrender.

In Xuchang City, Yingchuan County, in the palace that had been tidied up temporarily, Zhong Yu received the messenger sent by Han Kai. After some conversation, the messenger presented the letter on his body, and then bowed and left.

The letter was handed over to Zhong Yu's attendant, and several professional drug examiners and organists checked it, and found no trap or conspiracy, so they immediately turned to Zhong Yu, who had been waiting impatiently. .

Zhong Yu, who couldn't wait for a long time, opened the envelope quickly, and looked at the contents inside. Seeing the news in the envelope that Emperor Ling had surrendered, he knew he was going to receive it, and Zhong Yu felt a burst of excitement in his heart.

Finally, this day came. I came to the world's greatest enemy, the Han Dynasty, and I had already surrendered to myself at this moment. The time for me to unify the entire Three Kingdoms world is coming soon.

It has been two and a half years, and I have been in this world for so long, even longer than the time I have stayed in the main world, and finally I am a little tired of staying in this world without any extraordinary power!

Afterwards, if you add yourself to be destroyed, it may even take him more than half a year for the Han Dynasty to pacify the entire Three Kingdoms world, so that you may have to spend more time before you can go back.

But soon, I have already conquered Emperor Ling of Han, cut down the entire Han Dynasty, and pacified the whole world is just a stroke of the palm.

Now I am going to drive, rush to Luoyang, receive the inheritance of the entire Han Dynasty, and then use the name of Emperor Han Ling to order the world to surrender to myself.

Speed up the pace of conquering the entire Three Kingdoms world, so that it is not in vain for me to suppress the emotions in my heart and turn to compromise with the entire Three Kingdoms family.

An army of 100,000, followed by Zhong Yu, drove all the way to Luoyang City for tens of miles. Due to the large number of people, Zhong Yu refused to take less troops for his own safety, so he delayed. He arrived in Luoyang City a month later.

At this moment in Luoyang City, because of the emperor's delay in coming, some people were already in panic. Even Lingdi was a little panicked, thinking that Zhong Yu had repented, and wanted to take advantage of the fact that Luoyang City had been taken over by the army of the State of Wei, and killed him. He has no power to fight back.

However, after waiting for a month, he finally heard the emperor's arrival. Emperor Ling also looked pleasantly surprised, and brought a group of ministers who wanted to show courteousness to Zhong Yu to the gate of the city to welcome his imperial driver together.

At this moment, it is already high in the sun, around 2 o'clock in the afternoon. Lingdi, who had been waiting for him at the gate of the city for a long time, made his weak body sweat all over his body, his face was pale, his lips were bruised, and he looked unable to support himself.

However, when he was still able to hold on for a while, Zhong Yu's royal chariot finally arrived. It slowly drove to the gate of the city, and stopped in front of Emperor Ling.

At this time, Emperor Ling also felt relaxed, and finally reached this moment. After offering the Jade Seal of Chuanguo in his hand, he didn't have to worry about it, and he could happily bring his concubines to Peiguo and seal it.

Therefore, he turned around and took the plate of Jade Seal from the Chuanguo that was held in the hand of the attendant beside him. With his hands raised above his head, he came to the Royal Driver respectfully, and knelt down with a bend of his knees.

"Liu Hong, the ignorant king of the lower kingdom, now presents the jade seal of the upper kingdom and the household registration map to the sage king of the upper kingdom. I hope that the upper kingdom will forgive the little king for being stupid and generous."

After speaking, it was as if the jade seal in his hand was sent to the attendant of Yuguo in front, and he handed it over to Zhong Yu. After the attendant received the jade seal of Chuanguo, he didn't dare to neglect, and turned to Zhong Yu in a hurry.

Zhong Yu carefully sized and played with the stone in his hand. It represented the prosperity and power of the Three Kingdoms World for hundreds of years. Countless people shed blood and gave up everything to fight for it. At this time, he obediently stayed silent. In your own hands, let yourself dispose of it.

After a while, Zhong Yujiang, who was a little tired of playing, threw the stone on the plate under the distressed eyes of the guards beside him, and said to Lingdi Liu Hong who was still kneeling outside:

"Get up, after all, you are also the king of a country, and I don't want to humiliate you too much. From now on, you will go to Pei County to assume the post of feudal state, and be the Duke of Pei. Remember to guard the land and keep the people safe, and don't be distracted!"

Hearing this voice, Liu Hong was overjoyed. He had finally passed the test. He didn't have to worry about it anymore. He could be his own Pei Gong with peace of mind, and he didn't have to be afraid of others rebelling against him. It's a good ending, right?

"Yes, His Majesty Xie is magnanimous. Instead of pursuing the crimes of the subjugated ministers, he forgave more. I will be grateful for His Majesty's great kindness and dare not make trouble. From now on, I will be loyal to Your Majesty and guard the East." A voice of gratitude came from Liu Liu Hong said it out of his mouth, and listening to his words, it was actually somewhat true.

After appeasing them, he ignored them, and instead let the carriage drive to the Luoyang Palace where Emperor Ling had moved out for a long time.

At this time, he had already arranged his confidants, and any people in the palace who he could not trust were all kicked out, dismissed from all directions, and handed over to people he trusted to take over.

And then the territory followed by a group of ministers, the scene is quite funny, the person who used to sit on the emperor's seat is now following a group of his former courtiers, worshiping another person sitting in his seat.

I don't know if they are a little embarrassed, or they don't care about the relationship of shame and shame at all, they only care about what kind of position they can get in the next court, and what kind of rewards they can get?
